items.title: Steve "Ted" Brown Interview, 1958-04-22
items.q: I don't imagine so. He was evidently a young kid when I was gone.

ctx.x: Well, he's from New Orleans, but he was with Duke Ellington for a while. And he traveled all over with Ellington. Bro, no.
I don't imagine so. He was evidently a young kid when I was gone. No, I was about your...
In 192, he was born in 192, about two years younger.

items.title: Wellman Braud Interview, 1958-03-31
items.q: And a very fine fellow. And he thinks there's nobody in the world like me. Now he thinks I'm the greatest. And I think he's the greatest.

ctx.x: I met him in Detroit. His brother is still here.

And he's very, very fine. He didn't read anything. But I'm telling you, you couldn't tell a different way that your man just knew. He sat in in the Paul Whiteman Band. He made some of the finest records Paul Whiteman Band made in the bass line. The finest I heard. And a very fine fellow. And he thinks there's nobody in the world like me. Now he thinks I'm the greatest. And I think he's the greatest. See what I mean?
